attchmntText: Aaa Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AAA Technologies Limited approved un-audited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from operations was 671.18 Lakhs compared to 767.19 Lakhs in the previous year. Profit before tax stood at 148.74 Lakhs against 212.10 Lakhs previously. Net profit was 111.31 Lakhs versus 158.67 Lakhs. Basic earnings per share was 0.87 Rupees. The company changed its accounting policy to recognize revenue net of GST effective April 1, 2026. Comparative figures for the previous year were restated to reflect this change and the recognition of gratuity provisions. Control of the company was acquired by Jyotirgamya Advisory Private Limited and Mr. Ashok Kumar Chordia, who are now classified as promoters. The company entered a Memorandum of Understanding with Aikyam Stressed Assets Fund I for a resolution plan regarding Educomp Solutions Limited. A final dividend of 1.00 Rupees per share for the financial year 2025-26 was declared.

attchmntText: Aaa Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 07, 2026.
voiceSummary: AAA Technologies Limited approved the incorporation of four wholly owned subsidiaries during its board meeting on November 7, 2026. The entities include AAA Technologies Singapore Pte. Ltd. with a proposed capital of up to SGD 500,000, AAA Technologies Mauritius Limited with up to USD 500,000, AAA Technologies MENA FZCO in Dubai with up to AED 1,000,000, and AAA Semiconductor Private Limited in India with up to INR 20,00,000. The Singapore, Mauritius, and Dubai subsidiaries will focus on information systems audit, cybersecurity, IT assurance, and consulting services. The Indian subsidiary will undertake semiconductor design, integrated circuit development, and edge artificial intelligence processor research. The board granted in-principle approval for additional investments and financial support to these subsidiaries based on operational requirements. The proposed names are subject to regulatory approval.

attchmntText: Aaa Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 31, 2026.
